title: Northern Timbers RV Park & Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Northern Timbers RV Park & Campground is a family run, seasonal campground located in Grimshaw Alberta. Northern Timbers is a great option for camping by Peace River! Grimshaw is most well known for being the Mile Zero of the Mackenzie highway which can take you all the way up to Yellowknife! Young and old love to camp at this quaint, well kept Campground.
